setup.text: The farmer sets sticks and a handful of dirt against the soft ground and draws a line. "The festival week's planting is squeezed between every other job."

option_a.text: The player asks, "Does the ground matter?" The farmer pauses to glance down at the dark soil. "Has to be turned first. Packed ground just scuffs."

option_b.text: The player turns a second patch of soil with a hoe, then offers it for the same treatment. A clean furrow opens.

option_c.text: The player tries the cast on the nearby cobbled square, but the stone does not part.
